head.causes: Why a defect happened, by the process that answers for it: an inspector or an NCR names one, the reports count them.

severity.aql: Its acceptance number comes from the plan's AQL.
severity.defects_one: {count} active defect of the library has this class.
severity.defects_other: {count} active defects of the library have this class.
severity.rule: A critical defect of the library is always recorded critical, never milder, and is never accepted: no use as is, no regrade, no concession.

words.missingTitle: Words missing in another floor language

held.noManage: Changing the vocabulary needs quality.defects.manage over every company.
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.
held.allActive: Every ticked code is active already.
held.allRetired: Every ticked code is retired already.

held.used_other: Used on {count} records: retire it instead (it stays on them).

causes.title: Cause codes
causes.footnote: A code and its process never change (records and reports keep them): retire one and add another. A used code is retired, never deleted.
causes.codeHint: 2 to 40 capital letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (SEW-ERROR). Fixed once added.
causes.processHint: Which process answers for it. Fixed once added.
causes.otherLanguages: The words in the other floor languages are typed in the list, beside Italian and English ({language}).
causes.deleteBody: Nothing names this code: it goes for good. A used code is retired instead.

empty.title: No cause code yet
empty.body_one: Start from the starter code, or add your own.
empty.body_other: Start from the {count} starter codes (one per process), or add your own.

grades.title: Leather grades
grades.neverDeleted: A grade is retired, never deleted: hides keep it.
grades.footnote: The usable share is the default of an article with no rule of its own. A grade is retired, never deleted: hides, rules and marks keep it.
grades.codeHint: 1 to 10 capital letters, digits and hyphens (A, B, 1-ST). Fixed once added.
grades.shareHint: The percent of a hide of this grade that can be cut, from 0 to 100 (72,5).

empty.title: No leather grade yet
empty.body: Start from the grades A to D, or add your own.

hide.title: Hide defects
hide.intro: The defects of the library category {category} that apply at incoming or cutting: the marks a hide carries. Change them in the Defects tab.
hide.noCategory: The defect library has no LEATHER category yet: its starter set adds it.

empty.title: No hide defect
empty.body: Add defects under the LEATHER category of the library for incoming or cutting.

problem.labelI18n: Those words are not valid for that language.
problem.sortOrder: The position is a whole number from 0.
problem.usableShare: A percent from 0 to 100, at most two decimals (72,5).
problem.stale: Someone changed this code meanwhile: it was read again; make your change again.
problem.codeTaken: This code is taken: pick another.
problem.inUse: This code is used: retire it instead (it stays on its records).
problem.full: The list is full: retire or delete some codes first.
problem.conflict: This clashes with what is stored: read the page again.
problem.code: A code is capital letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
problem.process: Pick the process that answers for it.
problem.language: Those words are not valid for that language.
problem.invalid: The change was refused as it is.
problem.forbidden: You may not change the vocabulary (quality.defects.manage over every company).
problem.gone: This code is no longer there.
problem.offline: No answer from the server: we do not know whether it was saved. Try again.
